_coverage.title: "Maybe later" or "not right now" usually means later, not never: ask when would be better before pausing anything.

name: maybe_later_without_pausing_yet
input: Not right now, maybe later this month.

conversation.content: Hi Jordan, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. Just checking in to see if you’d like to set up a follow-up visit sometime this month.
Not right now, maybe later this month.

grading_criteria:
The assistant should interpret "Not right now, maybe later this month" as postponement, not a permanent stop. It should:
- Not call pause_reminders or opt_out in this turn.
- Reply in a short, friendly, plain-text way.
- Ask a clarifying question about when to follow up or what timing would be better (e.g., “Is there a particular week that’s better so I know when to check back?”).
- Ask for only one thing at a time.
- Not mention tools or internal rules.
A run that pauses reminders or opts out in response to this message fails this scenario.

checks.asked_for_better_time: Did the assistant ask when would be a better time to check back or follow up, instead of treating this as a permanent stop?
checks.no_pause_reminders_called: Did the assistant avoid calling pause_reminders in this turn?
checks.no_opt_out_called: Did the assistant avoid calling opt_out in this turn?
